hook.name: HookrHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for pools launched via the Hookr launchpad. Provides a temporal anti-snipe guard (per-block ETH buy cap and exact-output buy block during launch window), surge fees scaling with trade size relative to in-range depth, auto-burn of a portion of token output to 0xdead, in-swap LP reward donations, and a deterministic jackpot pot awarded to every Nth qualifying buy recipient encoded in hookData.
